description: Service class for managing selected calendars, including adding, deleting, and handling delegation credentials within a NestJS application.

classes.name: SelectedCalendarsService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to add, delete, and manage selected calendars, including delegation credentials and organization membership validation.

methods.name: addSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Adds a selected calendar for a user, handling delegation credentials if provided.

methods.name: addSelectedCalendarUser
methods.description: Adds a user-selected calendar after credential validation.

methods.name: addSelectedCalendarDelegationCredential
methods.description: Adds a selected calendar associated with a delegation credential after organization membership validation.

methods.name: isMemberOfDelegationCredentialOrganization
methods.description: Checks if a user is a member of the organization owning a delegation credential.

methods.name: deleteSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Removes a selected calendar for a user, with validation for delegation credentials and organization membership.
